solution_factual.find: In interference, the resultant intensity is always the sum of individual intensities if the phase difference is non-zero.
solution_factual.replace: In interference, the resultant intensity equals the sum of individual intensities only when the waves are incoherent (no fixed phase relationship); for coherent waves it depends on the phase difference.
solution_factual.why: The statement is factually incorrect for coherent interference.
